body:
**QA change, please review first.** With your OK in session, commit 1061bc4 touches only `qa/page.mjs` and swaps two checks for features this PR removes. Every other check and budget is unchanged.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| The intro gate shows on `?intro` | The page opens straight to the work |
| The sample card opens and closes | Every tile opens its dialog |

Unchanged: console errors, failed requests, sideways scroll, broken in-page links.

## Goal

From the owner: make the site a personal portfolio, and cut what wastes the visitor's time.

## Audit

| Part | Verdict | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Landing gate | Cut | It makes first-time visitors wait. |
| Selected work tiles | Keep | This is the portfolio. |

## Screenshots

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1440px | ![](https://github.com/example-owner/example-site/blob/task/portfolio-shots/before-desktop.png?raw=true) | ![](https://github.com/example-owner/example-site/blob/task/portfolio-shots/after-desktop.png?raw=true) |

## Decisions

- **No resume link.** A portfolio doesn't need one.
- **Role titles keep "Internship".** That's the factual title.

## Checks

- `node qa/static.mjs`: static: ok (11 asset paths, 43 ids)
- `node qa/page.mjs`: page: ok desktop 1440px / page: ok phone 375px
- Looked at the page at 1440px and 375px, including every dialog.
- **Independent review** (separate agent):
  - No runtime breakage. It checked deep links, print, reduced motion and the lightbox.
  - Lows fixed here: the stale share card and a duplicate pill.
  - Open: old anchors `#model` and `#risks` now land at the top.
- **Unslop pass:** applied the cover dedupe and the About rewrite.

## Left for you

- **Preview deploy.** The auto-mode check blocked the Vercel CLI here, and the repo has no Vercel git integration, so there's no preview link. Run `npx vercel@latest deploy --scope example-team` on this branch for one.
- **PLAN.md "your call" items:**
  - 6: Slide 8 wording
  - 8: Sign-off to show the deck
  - 10: custom domain
- **Sources to confirm:** two figures on the pipeline tile have no source note.

title: Make the site a personal portfolio, cut the gimmicks
